name: buildmylogic-vscode
description: Connects VS Code to BuildMyLogic learning sessions, capturing challenge evidence, test results, diagnostics, attempts, hints, and submissions.

commands.title: BuildMyLogic: Ask Vibe for a Hint

buildmylogic.serverUrl.description: BuildMyLogic web/backend URL. Keep Sarvam credentials on the backend.

buildmylogic.eventsPath.description: Backend event endpoint. {sessionId} is replaced automatically.

buildmylogic.contextPath.description: Backend endpoint for one-off VS Code context uploads.

buildmylogic.token.description: Optional pairing token. Never put a Sarvam API key here.

buildmylogic.testCommand.description: Command used by BuildMyLogic: Run Tests. It is executed only when the learner explicitly invokes the command.

buildmylogic.testTimeoutMs.description: Maximum test execution time in milliseconds.

buildmylogic.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum active-file content sent to the backend.

buildmylogic.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum test/terminal output sent to the backend.

buildmylogic.sendDiagnostics.description: Include VS Code Problems/diagnostics in session events.

buildmylogic.enableTerminalEvidence.description: Capture supported terminal shell-integration metadata. Disabled by default; use Run Tests for deterministic evidence.
